may  be  prescribed  upon  the  occurrence  of  the  following

(a)
unforeseen and unavoidable circumstances such as
major economic downturn, severe external shocks,
natural  disaster,  emergence  of  major  contingent
liabilities  or  any  such  other  eventuality  in  the
opinion of the Cabinet of Ministers;

(b)
it becomes necessary for a budgetary entity to incur
additional  expenditure  during  a  year  that  is  not
